column2: [From.GetTitledFirstName] seeks to inflame the hearts and minds of the people of [From.Capital.GetName] and nearby areas in order to raise an armed rebellion against [Root.GetTitledName], ideally resulting in [From.GetFirstName] being crowned as the new [From.GetKingQueen] of [From.Capital.Kingdom.GetBaseName].

With [Root.GetTitledName]'s claim to posess the Mandate of Heaven in doubt, [From.GetTitledFirstName] seeks to convince the people of [From.Capital.GetName] and nearby areas to take up arms in the name of a new imperial dynasty headed by [From.GetFirstName].

The [From.Culture.GetName] clans in [Root.GetTitledName]'s realm grow restless under [Root.GetHerHis] rule. [From.GetTitledName] seeks to convince their warriors to rise up and help [From.GetHerHis] overthrow the [Root.Culture.GetName] Yoke.
